feeds.title: Naval Association of Canada

feeds.title: Canadian Naval Review
feeds.description: Canadian Naval Review is published by the Brian Mulroney Institute of Government at St. Francis Xavier University. feeds.title: U.S Navy Aircraft History
feeds.description: My blog focuses on U.S. Navy Aircraft history. Hi! I'm Tommy H. Thomason. As a young boy in the 50s, I was always enamored with aeroplanes. However, I was not able to be a Naval Aviator because I was nearsighted, I instead became an aeronautical engineer and general aviation pilot. Now retired, I write books and monographs on U.S. Navy aircraft.

feeds.title: Navy Sports Nation

They make just as many personal sacrifices as those from the higher visibility sports, so I figured they deserved some love too. Stop by any time to engage in the topic of the day. I'll try to take more of an in depth look at Navy sports and their terrific athletes.
